# Lumi & friends — independent iOS apps

> A catalog of independent iOS apps with privacy-first design and one-time-purchase options where stated. Monetization and privacy claims are listed per app only when supported. Apps not yet public on the App Store are omitted automatically.

## Apps

### Photo & utility
- [Snapport](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780575828): Make your own at home in 30 seconds. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Passport Photo Maker and ID Photo.
- [PicClear](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780223070): Find duplicates & huge videos in one scan. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Gemini Photos and Smart Cleaner.
- [Unblurry](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782275018): AI super-resolution makes it crisp — on your iPhone. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Snapseed and Fotor.
- [PhotoCream](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781808054): 100+ real film looks, grain, halation & light leaks. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Snapseed and VSCO.

### Productivity
- [Sono Note](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782139553): Just talk — get clean notes, a summary & to-dos. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Microsoft OneNote and Google Keep.
- [CV Desk](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781337213): Instant ATS score + recruiter-ready templates. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Zety and Resume Builder.
- [ScanTo Pro](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779977651): Scan, OCR-search & Face ID-lock docs — pay once. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Scanbot and Adobe Scan.
- [LockHour Pro](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780107485): Block the apps that steal your focus — one tap. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Forest and Stay Focused.
- [Mochi](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6785004775): Cute, cozy checklists with a satisfying tap to complete — free, no ads. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Todoist and Ticktick.

### Health
- [Cyca](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782251621): See every phase, your best days & gentle days. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Flo and Ovia.

### Money & travel
- [G+Money](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6755782939): Convert + log every expense in one tap — offline. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to YNAB and Currency Converter Plus.
- [HoursTag](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6754218117): See what everything really costs — in hours of your life. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to YNAB and EveryDollar.

### Kids & learning
- [Lumi Letters](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6778748533): Playful phonics, tracing & letter games. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to ABCmouse and Endless Alphabet.
- [Lumi Math Planet](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6778269699): A whole galaxy of number adventures. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Endless Numbers and Math Kids.
- [Lumi Mission Planet](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779750237): A daily habit & bedtime ritual kids love. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to OurHome and ChoreMonster.
- [Lumi Weather](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779552704): Weather + a kid-outing score, tuned to their age. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to The Weather Channel and Weather Wiz Kids.
- [Lumi Letters Pro](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6778491147): The complete phonics, tracing & word-building world. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to ABCmouse and Endless Alphabet.
- [Lumi Math Pro](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6776958488): The whole number galaxy — every adventure unlocked. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Endless Numbers and Math Kids.
- [Lumi Mission Planet Pro](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6779745474): Habits, chores & bedtime kids actually want to do. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to OurHome and ChoreMonster.
- [Lumi Bopomofo](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6773017109): Zhuyin phonics, tracing & tone games — the first step to reading Chinese. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to ChineseSkill and HelloChinese.
- [Lumi Bopomofo Pro](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775773117): The complete Zhuyin (Bopomofo) world — every sound & game unlocked. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to HelloChinese and ChineseSkill.
- [Lumi Trip Planet](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787193643): Fun travel games, packing help & discovery for little explorers. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Road Trip Bingo and Toca Boca World.

### Kids & learning
- [Aim990](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6784974530): Daily L&R study plans, weak-spot drills & score tracking toward 990. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Toeic Vocabulary Builder and English Listening Speaking.
- [Wordmate: Learn 44 Languages](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789917808): Learn useful vocabulary in 44 languages with natural examples, a Home Screen widget and Apple Watch. Paid once. No subscription.
- [DailyMate](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790418321): Practice 8,400 useful phrases in 47 languages on iPhone, iPad, a Home Screen widget and Apple Watch. Paid once. No subscription.

### Travel
- [TripBee Pro: Trip Planner](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6787754435): Private offline day-by-day trip planner with smart family packing lists and one-tap Apple Maps directions. Paid once. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Wanderlog and TripIt.
- [TripBee Lite](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6791299610): Keep one active journey, daily timeline, tickets, reminders and maps together with no account. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription.

### Sleep & focus
- [Sereno](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6788236641): A high-end sound machine for sleep, focus & calm — free to try, unlock once. Free to start. One-time unlock. No subscription. A pay-once alternative to Calm and Bettersleep.
